name: hold-to-confirm
title: Hold to confirm
description: A button for actions that must not happen by accident: it fills while held and fires when full.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label shown before and while the button is held.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds the button must be held.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called once when the button has been held long enough, or confirmed with a second click.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Label shown on the button, and read aloud, once the action has fired.

props.name: hint
props.description: Said to screen readers, since holding is not obvious.

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible and spoken text; `armed` replaces the label after a single click, which waits for a second one.

a11y.text: Space or Enter held down fills the button, and releasing early drains it at twice the speed. The key repeat is ignored. It fires onConfirm when full, shows doneLabel for 2 seconds, then resets. The pointer works the same way, and the context menu is blocked. Losing focus stops the fill and empties it at once.

A click that no press or key came before it, as sent by some screen readers and switch controls, arms the button. The label changes to labels.armed (default Click again to confirm), and a second click within 4 seconds fires onConfirm. Otherwise the button disarms.

The hint (default Press and hold to confirm) sits in a hidden element that the button points to with aria-describedby. The white copy of the label on the fill is aria-hidden. A persistent status region announces doneLabel and the armed text.
Under reduced motion the fill jumps in steps of a quarter instead of sliding.
